name: Prasonisi
notes: Sandbar isthmus with two sides: waves on the west side, flatter lagoon on the east side (the wind is stronger and steadier there). Meltemi (NW) May–Sept, strongest July–Aug, a few knots above the rest of Rhodes; crowded in season. Schools teach on the lagoon, but one local site says kiting is restricted on the flat side: check the rules on the spot.

name: Marmari
notes: North-west coast of Kos, accelerated between the islands offshore: thermal meltemi (NW) from about noon to sunset, strong from June to September. Waist-deep sandbank about 50 m out, chop to small waves on windy days. The permitted kite zone is downwind where the beach is narrow with trees: tricky launch and landing. Several kite centres.

name: Psalidi
notes: North-east coast of Kos east of Kos Town, beach faces the strait to Turkey: side-onshore meltemi (N), strongest in the afternoon, shallow beginner-friendly water with chop. Kite centre on the beach, season May to October.

name: Afiartis – Makry Gialos
notes: Three bays near the airport (Chicken Bay for learning, Gun Bay, Devil's Bay): very strong and consistent meltemi from the north, over low land, flat water. A tour operator reports that kiting is not allowed in the bays while the windsurf centres are open (about 9:00–19:00): check locally. The dedicated kite beach is reported to be Agrilaopotamos, a few km away.

name: Mikri Vigla
notes: Meltemi (N), May–Sep, funnelled between Naxos and Paros: side-onshore, flat-ish water. A rocky headland splits the beach: kite on the north side, swimmers on the south. Narrow beach and rocky cape: some experience needed. Several IKO schools on site.

name: Pounta
notes: Channel towards Antiparos: the meltemi (N) is accelerated through the 1 km strait; flat in the shallows, choppy when it blows hard; current in the channel. Two kite centres; watch the Paros–Antiparos ferry route. Also: Golden Beach / New Golden Beach on the east coast (meltemi side-shore, chop; mainly windsurf).

name: Korfos
notes: North-west bay: the meltemi (N) is funnelled by the hills, strong late June to early September, gusty above 30 kt. Not very wide: ride upwind for space. Kite school on the beach; crowded in season.

name: Keros
notes: Wide shallow bay on the east coast; meltemi (N) side-shore, flat to choppy water. Kite and windsurf club on site.

name: Lefkada – Agios Ioannis
notes: Beach next to Lefkada town and the windmills; afternoon NW thermal (maistro), onshore with waves. Schools on site.

name: Kouremenos (Palaikastro)
notes: Funnelled meltemi (N–NW), side-offshore and gusty; flat to choppy water. Mostly a windsurf spot, experienced riders.

name: Epanomi – Potamos
notes: Sandy spit south of Thessaloniki; works with N–NW and S winds, flat water inside the spit. Schools on site. Also: Angelochori lagoon west of the airport (shallow flat water, good for learning).

name: Loutsa (Artemida)
notes: East Attica; meltemi (N–NE) side-shore, chop. Popular Athens spot with schools.

name: Schinias
notes: Long beach in the Marathon bay; meltemi (N–NE) side-offshore, flat water near shore. Experienced riders on gusty days.
